questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 15,625 for 1 year 6 months at 8% per annum, when compounded half-yearly?
questions.solution:

Principal = Rs. 15625

Time = 1 year 6 months

Rate% = 8% p.a. compounded half yearly

**Formula Used:**

When calculate at compound interest

Amount (A) = p (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where p, r and n respectively are principal, rate of interest and time

**Calculation:**

Here the rate of interest is compounded half yearly

Effective rate of interest = 8%/2 = 4%

Effective cycle of time = 3

A = 15625 (1 + 4/100)³

⇒ A = 17576

Compound interest = Amount – principal

∴ Compound interest = 17576 – 15625 = Rs. 1951

questions.solution:

• On a hot dry day, the **temperature is high** and** humidity is less** which helps in better evaporation.
 
• Due to the **higher rate **of evaporation, **it gives better cooling effect**. **Hence,** statement 2 is correct.
 
• That is why a **desert cooler** cools better on a hot dry day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• When the humidity is high it feels oppressive outside because sweat doesn't evaporate and provide cooling.

• If the amount of water vapour present in the air is less, then evaporation is more.

• **The kinetic energy of object = 1/2 mv²,**

 Acids are those when dissolves in water produce H+ ions, they are sour in taste, turns blue litmus to red.

•

• Salts are the neutral compounds, formed by the ionic reaction between acids and bases, they are salty in taste. salts are electrically neutral.
 
• On the pH scale, acids having a pH less than 7, bases having a pH More than 7, and salts are having a pH value equal to 7 for neutral salts (strong acid and strong base).
 
• Acidic salts are the salts with weak base and strong acid pH less than 7, for example- NH4Cl.
 
• 
 Basic salts are the salts with weak acid and strong base pH of more than 7, for example- Na2CO3.

questions.question: In CO₂, C and O₂ are present in the ratio ______ by mass
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__3:8.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Mass-** It is a measure of the amount of matter in an object. It is usually measured in grams or kilograms.
 
• In Chemistry, Mass ratio often called **"per cent composition by mass", is the proportion of a particular molecule that consists of each that molecule's constituent elements.**
 
• This principle gives rise to the law of constant proportion by Joseph Proust in 1800.
 
 
• A given compound always has the same proportion by mass of its constituent elements.
 
• For example - **water always has exactly 8gm of oxygen for every 1gm of hydrogen, i.e.** **1:8. **
 
 
 
• The mass is calculated by the mass number of an element given in the periodic table and represented by 'A' in an element.
 
• The mass of hydrogen in H₂O is 2×1 = 2gm (it contains 2 moles of hydrogen) and the mass of oxygen in H₂O is 16gm (it contains 1 mole of oxygen) = 2:16 = 1:8.
 
• As the mass number of oxygen is 16 and the mass number of hydrogen is 1.

**CALCULATION:-**

 
• The mass of carbon in CO₂ is 12gm (carbon has one molecule).
 
• The mass of oxygen in CO₂ is 2×16 = 32gm (oxygen has two molecules)
 
• So, the ratio of their masses is 12:32 = 3:8.
 
• **In 1 mole of CO₂, there is 1 mole of carbon and 2 moles of oxygen.**

• **The unit 'watt' is very small. Therefore, in actual practice, we use a much larger unit called 'kilowatt'. it is equal to 1000 watts.**
 
• **Electric energy is the product of power and time, the unit of electric energy is 'watt-hour' ( W h).**
 
• ** 1 watt-hour** is the energy consumed when 1 watt of power is used for 1 hour. The commercial unit of electric energy is kilowatt-hour (KW h), commonly known as **Units.**
 
• **1 KW h = 1000 watts × 3600 seconds = 3.6 × 10⁶ watt second = 3.6 × 10⁶ joule (J).**

questions.question: A is three years older than B and the age of C is twice that of B. What is the age of A, if the sum of the ages of A, B and C is 35?
questions.solution:
Let the age of B be x years.

A = x + 3 and C = 2x

According to question:

(x + 3) + x + 2x = 35

⇒ x + 3 + x + 2x = 35

⇒ 4x = 35 – 3

⇒ 4x = 32

⇒ x = 8

So, A’s age = (x + 3) = (8 + 3) = 11 years.

Hence, ’11 years’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: ______ are comparatively poor conductors of heat.

• Metals are usually the best conductors of thermal energy metals are chemically bonded: metallic bonds (as opposed to covalent or ionic bonds) have free-moving electrons which are able to transfer thermal energy rapidly through the metal.

• The heat flows from a hotter object to a colder object. The process by which heat is transferred from the hotter end to the colder end of an object is known as **conduction**.
 
• The materials which allow heat to pass through them easily are conductors of heat. For examples, aluminium, iron and copper.
 
• The materials which do not allow heat to pass through them easily are poor conductors of heat such as plastic and wood.
 
• **Poor conductors are known as insulators.**
